evidence.quote: We accept applications from October 15, 2026 until May 15, 2027.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 9,100 EUR per semester for applicants from all countries, while the WHU English 'Fees & Financing' page states €9,300 per semester; the German page also states 9.300 € pro Semester. The value above uses the higher, more recent figure; note the discrepancy. Art. 27(1) sentence 1 (fact 4.6): The three admission rounds (31 January 2027, 31 March 2027, 15 May 2027) are general deadlines without an explicit statement that they are for non-EU applicants; they were NOT therefore used as applicationDeadline. Fact 4.6 also notes a later sentence: 'Applicants who need a visa are highly encouraged to apply for the first admission round.' This recommends rather than requires the first round. Fact 4.7 cites the recurring deadline 15 May but the WHU page describes it as the deadline for English-test results and internship proof, NOT as the application deadline, so no recurringDeadline is output. Fact 4.8 (requirements): English proficiency is required (TOEFL/IELTS or Cambridge C1); software did not state a global duration figure. The DAAD page states 'German language skills No minimum language level required', so German is not a requirement. Runtime assistance only flagged the two risks; PASS.

note.en: A secondary school diploma (or equivalent) is required for admission; check your eligibility.
